_comment: The ONNX Runtime the screenshot OCR loads at run time. scripts/fetch-onnxruntime.ps1 downloads this wheel, checks both digests and unpacks the library into src-tauri/resources/ort; a test of the OCR engine checks the library against dllSha256 too. To move to another version: take the win_amd64 wheel from https://pypi.org/pypi/onnxruntime/<version>/json and update all four fields.
